Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: wide triangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: sculptural fringe. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette terracotta-black. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
